title: Real-Time Plasma State Prediction via FPGA-Accelerated Quantized Recurrent Probabilistic Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2609.23141v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Real time plasma state estimation for control of Tokamak devices are challenging due to the stringent latency requirements of the plasma control system (PCS). We present an end-to-end workflow for deploying a recurrent probabilistic neural network (RPNN) on FPGA hardware. We combine architecture size reduction with quantization-aware training via QKeras. The model is then synthesized using hls4ml, targeting a Xilinx Alveo U50 device. We report a design that fits comfortably within all four resource budgets (DSP, LUT, FF, BRAM) at deterministic sub-10~$\mu$s single-timestep latency, meeting the requirements for real-time inference inside a model-predictive-control-style plasma control loop.

translated_title: 基于FPGA加速的量化循环概率神经网络的等离子体状态实时预测
translated_abstract: 由于等离子体控制系统（PCS）对延迟的严格要求，面向托卡马克装置控制的等离子体状态实时估计极具挑战性。我们提出了一种将循环概率神经网络（RPNN）部署到FPGA硬件上的端到端工作流程。该方法将网络架构尺寸缩减与基于QKeras的量化感知训练相结合，随后使用hls4ml对模型进行综合，目标硬件为Xilinx Alveo U50设备。我们报告的设计在全部四项资源预算（DSP、LUT、FF、BRAM）内均留有充足余量，同时实现了确定性的低于10微秒的单步延迟，满足了模型预测控制式等离子体控制回路中实时推理的要求。
tldr: 该研究提出一种端到端工作流程，通过QKeras量化感知训练与hls4ml综合将循环概率神经网络部署到FPGA上，实现了确定性的亚10微秒单步延迟，满足托卡马克等离子体实时控制需求。
en_tdlr: This work presents an end-to-end workflow that deploys a quantized recurrent probabilistic neural network on FPGA hardware via QKeras quantization-aware training and hls4ml synthesis, achieving deterministic sub-10 microsecond single-timestep latency for real-time Tokamak plasma control.
